observations: Photo 0 shows a large FDM 3D printer with a blue printed castle model on the build plate. The brand 'ELEGOO' is visible on the top bar.
Photo 1 shows the same printer without the printed model, with a black strap attached to the print head. The brand 'ELEGOO' is again visible on the top bar.
The printer has a large rectangular frame, a dual Z-axis system, and a touchscreen control panel on the front right.
The build plate is square and appears to be made of glass or a similar material, with a gold-colored surface.
The printer has a coiled cable connecting the touchscreen to the main body.
Both photos are studio-style with a white background and watermarks: 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'TOVIDE BUSINESS WORLD'.

claims.claim: The ELEGOO Neptune 3 Max is a large-format FDM 3D printer designed for big projects and batch...
claims.evidence: The photos show a large FDM 3D printer with the brand and model name visible on the top bar in both photos. The size and structure are consistent with a large-format printer.

risks.risk: The printer may not be functional or may have internal damage not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the printer powering on, the touchscreen responding, and the print head moving smoothly along the X, Y, and Z axes.

risks.risk: The printer may have been previously used and has wear or damage to components like belts, rods, or the hotend.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the print head, belts, rods, and build plate showing no signs of wear, damage, or residue.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used with unknown condition

risks.risk: The included accessories (e.g., power supply, cables, filament) may be missing or damaged.
risks.proof: Photos of all included accessories laid out and in good condition.

proof_requests: Video of the printer powering on and moving the print head.
Close-up photos of the print head, belts, rods, and build plate.
response.reason: The brand and model are clearly visible, but the functional condition, internal wear, and completeness of accessories cannot be verified from the current photos. These factors significantly affect the price and must be confirmed before pricing.
